answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: rotating-witness re-attestation. Standing is not granted once; it is renewed each window by a fresh random panel of established peers. A fake cannot permanently co-opt one friendly set, because witnesses rotate every window - sustaining it means corrupting an ever-changing sample, a recurring cost not a one-time one. A ring that bribes today's panel faces a new delta tomorrow and must bribe again. Honest standing mirrors repeated peer judgment; borrowed approval erodes when the panel shifts. The attacker climbs no stable ridge: every window resets who vouches.
